text_block_list.text:
"On the way back from an errand. Since we'd been walking
for a while, my throat was dry, so I took out my water bottle—"
choice_data_list: Ume kombu tea hits different when you drink it outside.
Ume kombu tea tastes extra special when you have it outside, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer,
you're drinking it for me?

Ever since hearing that "plum kombu tea relieves fatigue"
on our last outing, it has become a staple of mine.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, it's been a huge help.
Thanks to you, it's been a really big help!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm glad I had my grandmas
teach me so much beforehand.
choice_data_list: What other kinds of things do you have?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, there are quite a few...
Um, if you'd like, shall I show you around a few of them?
And so, Nishino Flower's soothing tour began.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
How does it feel, Trainer?
Basking in the sun while looking at flowers...
doesn't it make you feel all soft and fluffy~?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm starting to relax a bit.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Really? That's great!
All right, let's find something even more relaxing—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"O-Oh, there's a bench over there,
so why don't we sit down and take a good look!"

And so,
gazing at the flowers with Nishino Flower—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... The flowers smell so nice.
I'm starting to feel so fluffy and relaxed~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hah...!
I-I fell asleep...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, it's already evening...
L-Let's head to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! So good...!
The sweetness of the dried persimmon just melts in your mouth...
choice_data_list: It tastes kind of nostalgic, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, me too! I used to sit in front of the storefront like this with the old lady next door and eat.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The shopkeeper often threw in a little extra
as a bonus for me...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, even though I say it brings back memories,
it really wasn't that long ago.
Even after that, guided by Nishino Flower, the simple, leisurely time felt nostalgic and wonderfully soothing...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I think that's about all I can do today.
...How did it look to you?
choice_data_list: Thanks, it's been a great day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... to be honest, I've been worried this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The things I enjoy are a bit unusual
compared to other people my age.
...However.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I... really love it, you know.
Spending my time nice and relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Like the warm feeling of the sun
when I went on walks with Grandma
when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So... I'm really happy right now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Getting to do that together with Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding... Ehehe,
falling asleep right in the middle of giving a tour means I still have a long way to go, doesn't it?
choice_data_list: I feel bad just constantly being on the receiving end.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Hehe, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sure
I'll be able to guide you around much better next time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: For my kind Trainer's sake, I'll do my best... yes, I will!

If it gets any more relaxing than this, I might just fall asleep next time...
Even so, I'm looking forward to the next tour.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What?! That's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I'm the one who's always being supported...!
I've caused you so much trouble, too!"
choice_data_list: Let me thank you properly someday, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... in that case, I'll just have to
thank you even more!

Afterward, we headed home
while repeatedly thanking each other.
